stemBlocks: A block of mass $3.60 \text{ kg}$ is held stationary on a rough slope inclined at $30.0^\circ$ to the horizontal. The edge X of the block is $1.50 \text{ m}$ from the bottom of the slope. The block is released and it accelerates uniformly down the slope. When X reaches the bottom of the slope, the speed of the block is $2.00 \text{ m s}^{-1}$.
What is the average rate at which work is done against resistive forces? (gravitational field strength = $10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}$)
